resolution.note:
Both refuters killed every blocking finding, so the row stamps PASS:verify-refuted and this REVISE stays as the record. pedagogy §47 line 89: harm: Most of the judge's facts check out. Five fences sit at L23/L41/L47/L59/L73 across four phases. apt101-choose-the-bet L66 and apt101-grow-the-tree L93 do carry "Failure modes:" lines. grep confirms the maintainer block of apt101-write-the-bet has no Failure modes or Watch-for line. One locator is wrong: the block opens at L87, and L89 is the Quality stamp. So the rule technically fires. The finding fails as BLOCKING on the harm lens.

(d) No-op. The fix moves into the maintainer block four failure-mode/recovery pairs that the body already states in trainer-readable prose. L27: "Push back on an outcome that is really an output... ask what the customer does differently." L37: "'Users like it' can only say yes." L63: "every sticky ends up in the important half. Push until a few drop." L69/L75: "If the dots split, leave them split... the bet file keeps both." The maintainer block's own Workshop shape line (L102) already says "Split dots are recorded, not resolved by Claude." The judge's evidence admits that body prose already holds these. The trainer in the room reads this page, and I found no APT101 trainer page built from maintainer blocks. So nobody in the room is worse off. The harm claim ("no per-phase lookup") restates the rule and names no consequence.

(a)/(b) Severity is out of line with its siblings. In the same training and the same pedagogy judge class, the apt101-what-goes-in instance filed the identical §47 gap as REVISE with blocking:false. In this very instance, the parallel maintainer-block gap §45 (no leap test) is also non-blocking. Rule §47 itself prescribes REVISE ("Either unanswered → REVISE") and does not prescribe a block. Its "ship without both" clause is aimed at story judges.

The "siblings carry it" argument is selective. 11 of the 18 APT101 exercises have no "Failure modes" line (grep -L), so it is not a training-wide convention whose absence marks this file as defective.

At most this is a non-blocking §47 REVISE row for the card queue, or a maintainer-block tidy-up. It is not a blocking defect.
